content: Good. Now let me check what the two existing papers have recorded.

args.sql:
SELECT p.title, p.year, p.method, p.publish, p.category, c.link, c.repo_info
FROM paper p
LEFT JOIN code c ON p.code_id = c.id
WHERE p.title IN (
    'PANGOLIN: Fuzzing Multilingual IoT Firmware with LLM-Driven Code Analysis',
    'ChatHTTPFuzz: Large Language Model-Assisted IoT HTTP Fuzzing'
);
